subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation IDs while preserving existing account-scoped `--bind <channel>:<account>` behavior?
rationale: The current patch makes a public CLI/config compatibility choice by reinterpreting `feishu:<value>` and adding an account escape; automation cannot safely choose that product contract across the competing open PRs.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
options.body: Keep documented two-segment account binding intact and add a clear peer/conversation form with docs, tests, and migration guidance.

options.title: Use Feishu-specific inference with an account escape
options.body: Accept channel-specific parsing for Feishu IDs only if maintainers intentionally own the upgrade risk and document the escape path.

options.title: Pause this PR for a sibling candidate
options.body: Choose another open candidate if it better matches the desired compatibility contract, then close remaining candidates after one fix merges.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
recommendation.body: Keep documented two-segment account binding intact and add a clear peer/conversation form with docs, tests, and migration guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership touches the bind parser and routing surface, so this is the best available routing point for a grammar decision.
